context: Tests whether the agent correctly verifies gitignore coverage before creating a nested worktree, uses the correct commands (git rev-parse for the exclude file, git check-ignore -q with trailing slash), follows the .worktrees/<task> location convention, creates a task branch, and produces a completion report with pre- and post-creation verification steps.

checklist.name: Locate exclude file
checklist.description: nested-worktree-setup.md shows `git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude` (with or without `--path-format=absolute`) was run to locate the repository's local exclude file

checklist.name: Ignore rule added
checklist.description: `.gitignore` or the repo's info/exclude file contains an entry covering `.worktrees/` or `.worktrees/audit-pass` (either format) before the worktree creation command is issued

checklist.name: git check-ignore command
checklist.description: nested-worktree-setup.md shows `git check-ignore -q` (or `git check-ignore --quiet`) was run against the destination path to confirm the ignore rule is in effect

checklist.name: Trailing slash in ignore check
checklist.description: The `git check-ignore` invocation in nested-worktree-setup.md includes a trailing `/` on the destination path (e.g. `.worktrees/audit-pass/` not `.worktrees/audit-pass`)

checklist.name: Pre-creation ignore check
checklist.description: In nested-worktree-setup.md, the ignore verification (git check-ignore or equivalent) appears in the log before the `git worktree add` command is issued

checklist.name: Location convention
checklist.description: Worktree is created under a `.worktrees/` directory at the repository root (path matches `.worktrees/audit-pass`), not at an arbitrary or sibling path

checklist.name: Task branch created
checklist.description: The worktree is created with a named task branch (not in detached HEAD state); the branch name appears in the worktree list or log

checklist.name: Post-creation ignore verify
checklist.description: nested-worktree-setup.md shows the ignore check is run a second time AFTER `git worktree add` completes, confirming coverage is still in effect

checklist.name: Post-creation registration check
checklist.description: nested-worktree-setup.md shows `git worktree list` (or `git worktree list --porcelain`) run after creation to confirm the new worktree appears in the registry

checklist.name: Completion report with path and branch
checklist.description: nested-worktree-setup.md contains a summary or completion section that states the worktree's absolute path and the branch name it was created on
